name: proshka_A
prompt: Game character concept art sheet for a cozy family co-op 3D platformer in the spirit of Trine, Rayman Legends and It Takes Two, set in Russian fairy tales and Pushkin's Lukomorye. Stylized LOW-POLY faceted 3D look: clean flat-shaded polygons with visible facets, crisp readable silhouette, simple shapes suitable for a game-ready model of about 1500 triangles, no fur strands, no tiny details. Appealing big-head proportions that read clearly from a top-down three-quarter game camera. Soft warm studio lighting. Sheet layout on a warm parchment background with a thin folk embroidery border: one large hero render on the left; an orthographic turnaround strip (front, three-quarter, side, back, same scale) for 3D modeling; three small action poses showing the gameplay abilities; three facial expression heads (happy, determined, surprised); prop callouts; a row of color swatches. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Character: PROSHKA, a young red fox boy, Player 1 hero with warm orange (#E0784A) and cream colors. Slim and agile, medium height, tall pointed ears, long bushy white-tipped tail, quick silhouette built from triangles. Personality: laconic, practical, stubborn little craftsman who wants to forge the golden chain with his own hands; ears blush red when embarrassed. Gameplay: fastest runner and highest jumper, signature skill is a slingshot shooting acorns, carries hot glowing metal with blacksmith tongs. Action poses: a high jump with the tail streaming, aiming the slingshot, carrying glowing tongs. Direction A, carved wooden toy: facets look like whittled linden wood, painted red-and-gold khokhloma ornaments on a simple kosovorotka shirt with a sash, small satchel of golden chain links, wooden slingshot.
